Tagcast 0.81.0 beta 1 is a candidate for optional gapless album playback, with a dedicated Settings page and public iBroadcast service health on Overview. Gapless remains experimental and off by default.

## Let continuous albums flow

For a supported FLAC album, choose **Settings → Playback → Original file (Premium)**, save the quality, enable **Gapless playback for albums in order**, then start with **Play album**. The current track keeps its own time bar, while consecutive album tracks share a continuous buffer underneath. Volume, playback speed, output selection and the existing queue remain available.

Starting can take longer while audio is prepared. Seeking close to a boundary can briefly wait for the next track. Unsupported files, incompatible decoder formats/block sizes and preparation or playback failures safely use normal playback. Existing silence in a recording is preserved; there is no crossfade or silence trimming.

This option applies to normal album order. Shuffle album, Random Album, playlists and active queue synchronisation use standard playback. Original FLAC is the primary measured path. MP3 remains separately experimental and requires usable encoder timing metadata; real-stream sample alignment is not established across all MP3 streams. Exact synthetic FLAC measurements do not imply universal gapless accuracy across files, platforms or audio devices.

## Settings that are easier to find

Settings now opens as a normal page with Interface, Playback, Discovery, Sources & keys, Data & exports and About & updates categories. Existing preferences and save behaviour are retained. Now playing view and compact-player choices live under Playback. Sidebar shortcuts are directly visible under Interface. Back/Forward navigation, editor drafts and review/save protections remain available.

## Check public service health

Overview includes **iBroadcast Service Status** for Streaming, API Server, Play Queue, Artwork and Library Generation, using the official public feed. It distinguishes public service health from your account connection, shows retrieval/report times and stale/unavailable information, and refreshes about every five minutes while Overview is visible. Missing or stale data is not shown as confirmed current Operational status.

## Included library improvements

This candidate also contains the already prepared album browsing changes since 0.80.0: reviewed tags for selected albums, deselection after confirmed tag assignments, Shuffle album, stable Random album ordering and a shorter two-column Filter and sort menu. Various Artists editing makes cleared additional album credits visible in the draft/review workflow.

## Testing and availability

This is a **local candidate preparation**, not a published release. The private listening app's separate profile and write restrictions are not part of the production candidate: normal sign-in/settings, play reporting, queue sync and reviewed library operations remain available. Gapless and optional anonymous diagnostics remain opt-in. No audio engine rewrite is included.

The macOS Apple Silicon candidate is checked locally. Windows, Linux and Intel macOS candidate builds must pass the existing CI workflow before multi-platform publication; a successful earlier main build does not validate this candidate. See `docs/gapless-rc-validation.md` for the precise measured/tested scope and remaining gates. No release or tag has been created.
